app.name: Dhara
app.tagline: Cases, dates, clients — all in one flow.

login.title: Sign in to your chamber
login.subtitle: One login for everyone. The app sets itself up for your role.
login.noRoleTitle: No need to pick a role
login.noRoleBody: Your chamber owner chose your role when they invited you. It turns on after you sign in.
login.security: Two-step verification is on. Platform admins sign in on a separate link.
login.verifySent: We sent a 6-digit code by SMS to {phone}. It works for 5 minutes.
login.passwordHint: You can set a password in Settings after you sign in with OTP once.
login.twoStepBody: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.

placeholder.title: Not built yet
placeholder.body: This screen is built in milestone {milestone}.

admin.title: Platform admin
admin.banner: Super admin portal · separate link · two-step verification required

login.title: Admin sign-in
login.hint: Phone, password and the code from your authenticator app, every time.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Counts across the platform. No client or case content.

chambers.subtitle: Every chamber on the platform. Client and case content is not visible here.
chambers.privacyNote: Client names, contact, case details and documents are not visible in this portal.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Subscription payments entered by hand. Payment gateways come later.

support.how1: An admin sends a request with a reason
support.how2: The chamber owner approves in the app
support.how3: It closes by itself after 24 hours; every action stays in the audit log
support.contactHidden: Even after approval, client contact stays hidden.
support.reasonHint: The owner sees this. At least 10 characters.
support.sent: Request sent. The owner decides in the app.
support.alreadyOpen: A request is already waiting or open for this chamber.
support.subtitle: Requests to chamber owners and their answers.
support.viewSubtitle: Case numbers, courts and dates only, while the owner's approval lasts.
support.noGrant: There is no approved, unexpired support access for you on this chamber.
support.logged: Each opening of this page is recorded in the chamber's activity log and the admin audit log.

team.subtitle: Platform staff. New admins are added on the server, not from this portal.

errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a Bangladeshi mobile number, like 01712345678.
errors.rateLimited: Too many codes sent to this number. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.codeInvalid: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
errors.codeExpired: This code has expired. Send a new one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong tries. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.
errors.credentialsInvalid: Mobile number or password is not right.
errors.consentRequired: Tick the box to agree before you continue.
errors.chamberInvalid: Write the chamber name (at least 2 letters). The address can be up to 200 letters.
errors.inviteInvalid: Write the name and choose a role.
errors.alreadyMember: This number is already a member of your chamber.
errors.caseInvalid: Fill in the case type, number, year (4 digits) and court.
errors.dateInvalid: Choose today or a later date.
errors.courtInvalid: Choose a court from the list.
errors.caseNotFound: This case is not open to you.
errors.contactInvalid: Check the email and the NID number (10, 13 or 17 digits).
errors.clientConsentRequired: Tick the box confirming the client agreed, then save the contact details.
errors.memberInvalid: Could not save. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.taskInvalid: Write the task (at least 2 letters) and choose who it is for.
errors.adminCredentialsInvalid: Phone, password or code did not match. Check them and try again.
errors.planInvalid: Choose a plan and status; the trial end must be a date.
errors.paymentInvalid: Choose the case and a date that is not in the future.
errors.reasonInvalid: Write the reason in 10 to 1000 characters.
errors.fileTooBig: The file is larger than 20 MB. Choose a smaller file or take a photo instead.
errors.fileType: Only PDF, JPG and PNG files can be added.
errors.photoFormat: This photo format cannot be opened here. Take the photo with the Scan button or use a JPG.
errors.documentInvalid: Could not add the document. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.uploadFailed: The upload did not finish. Check the connection and try again.
errors.feeInvalid: Write what the fee is for and the amount in taka, like 5000.
errors.referenceNeeded: Write the bKash or Nagad transaction ID.
errors.noDue: Nothing is due on this case.
errors.noPhone: This client has no phone number saved. Add it on the client's page.
errors.amountInvalid: Write the amount in taka, like 5000.
errors.reminderTimeInvalid: Choose a time for each reminder.

twoStep.title: Turn on two-step verification
twoStep.why: Chamber owners must use it. Even if someone gets your OTP, they cannot open your chamber without your phone's authenticator app.
twoStep.scan: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
twoStep.manual: Or type this key in the app:
twoStep.recoveryBody: Write these recovery codes down and keep them safe. If you lose your phone, each one works once. They will not be shown again.

onboarding.consent1: Dhara keeps your chamber's cases, dates and client details so your team can work together.
onboarding.consent2: Client phone, email, NID and address are encrypted. Only the chamber owner can see them.
onboarding.consent3: Our platform staff cannot see client data. Support needs the owner's approval and ends after 24 hours.
onboarding.consent4: Who viewed or changed sensitive data is kept in an activity log the owner can read.
onboarding.consent5: Get your clients' consent before you add their personal details.
onboarding.consentNote: The full privacy notice will be published after legal review.
onboarding.agree: I have read this and agree
onboarding.title: Set up your chamber
onboarding.subtitle: Takes 2 minutes. You can edit everything later.
onboarding.district: Which district's courts you go to most
onboarding.next2: 2. Import cases from an old diary or Excel (skip if you like)
onboarding.orOwn: Or set up your own chamber
onboarding.importBody: Importing from Excel or an old diary is coming soon. Skip for now; you can import later from Cases.
onboarding.inviteBody: Add associates, your munshi and office staff. Each gets only what their role allows.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.wrongPhone: This invitation is for {phone}. Log out and sign in with that number.
invite.invalid: This invitation link has expired or was withdrawn. Ask the chamber owner to send a new one.

team.subtitle: Set who can see and do what.
team.name: Name
team.roleAssociate: Assigned cases, dates and AI drafts. Will not see client contact.
team.roleMunshi: Today's list, next dates and order photos.
team.roleStaff: Which file goes to which court today, and tasks given to them.
team.inviteNote: The invite goes by SMS. The role turns on after their first sign-in; you can change or turn it off any time.
team.removedNotice: Member removed. Their cases stay in the chamber.
team.feesLabel: Can see fees, dues and income
team.feesHint: Off by default. Only for this associate.
team.contactLocked: Client phone, email, NID and address stay with the owner only. This cannot be changed.
team.removeBody: {name} will no longer be able to open this chamber. Their cases and tasks stay for you to reassign.
team.adminNote: Even the platform's super admin cannot see your clients' details. Support needs your approval, closes itself after 24 hours, and every action stays in the activity log.

matrix.title: Permissions by role
matrix.lockNote: A lock means it cannot be changed
matrix.adjustable: You can change two things per associate: which cases they see (all or assigned) and whether they see fees.

today.summary: {hearings, plural, one {# hearing} other {# hearings}} · {courts, plural, one {# court} other {# courts}}
today.munshiLock: Client phone, fees and private documents are not shown on this account.
today.staffLock: Client names, contact, fees and documents are not shown on this account.

cases.title: Cases
cases.noResults: No cases match. Try another number or name.
cases.emptyBody: Add your first case. Importing from an old diary or Excel is coming soon.
cases.emptyNoAdd: Cases the chamber adds will show here.

caseForm.title: New case
caseForm.clientPlaceholder: Type a name, or a new one to add
caseForm.more: Add more details (parties, opposing counsel, note)
caseForm.partiesPlaceholder: e.g. Karim Hossain vs Rafiq Uddin and others
caseForm.deleteConfirm: Yes, delete this case. It disappears for everyone in the chamber; the deletion is kept in the activity log.
caseForm.deleteNeedsConfirm: Tick the box first to confirm.

caseDetail.title: Case
caseDetail.emptyTimeline: Nothing recorded yet. After each hearing, add the next date and what happened.
caseDetail.officialNote: Opens the court's own website. Dhara does not fetch anything from it.

nextDate.title: Add next date
nextDate.serial: Serial or item no. on the new date (if known)

clients.title: Clients
clients.caseCount: {count, plural, =0 {No active cases} one {# active case} other {# active cases}}
clients.assignedCount: {count, plural, one {# case assigned to you} other {# cases assigned to you}}
clients.empty: No clients yet. Add one here, or when you add a case.

client.title: Client
client.privateBody: Phone, email, NID and address are visible only to the chamber owner.
client.activity: Who viewed this and when is kept in the activity log
client.consent: The client agreed to us keeping these details
client.name: Name
client.contactOwnerOnly: Only the owner can add contact details.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.subtitle: Who did what in this chamber, newest first. Changed details are not shown here.

tasks.title: Task
tasks.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Take the file to Joint District Judge Court 2

support.title: Support access
support.heading: Platform support is asking for access to your chamber

support.bannerPending: Platform support is asking for access

documents.title: Name
documents.recentHint: Recent documents from the cases you can open. Add new ones from a case.

receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.lightNote: The receipt stays like white paper even in dark mode, so print and PDF look the same.

reminders.enable: Turn on notifications on this phone

reminders.denied: Notifications are blocked for Dhara in this browser. Allow them in the browser settings, then try again.

reminders.notConfigured: Notifications are not set up on this server yet.

print.footer: Made with Dhara. Check dates against the court's cause list.
